meta.purpose: What the YouTube Data API returned for each film in the record, verified against the live channel. Provider metadata, kept deliberately apart from anything the Fondom asserts about its own history.
meta.source: youtube/v3 playlistItems on the channel's own uploads playlist, read through src/lib/youtube-sync.ts. Read-only; nothing was written to YouTube.
meta.rule: This layer fills publishedTitle and sets titleVerified. It NEVER touches displayTitle, category, group, context, ordering, state or featured - those are the archive's own editorial record, and a channel title is not evidence about Guneku's history. All 46 provider titles differ from the site's titles, which is expected: the channel writes for YouTube search, the archive writes for the Fondom.
meta.precedence: canonical source record < this provider layer (publishedTitle only) < video-overrides.json (everything editorial).
meta.whatPublishedAtIsNot: publishedAt is when the video was uploaded to YouTube. It is NOT the date of the occasion filmed, it is not rendered as one anywhere, and it must never be used as one. Four of these were uploaded in 2015 and thirty-six in 2024; that says nothing about when anything happened.

fields.providerTitle: The channel's own title for this video, as returned by the API.
fields.publishedAt: The upload timestamp YouTube returned. Provider metadata, not an event date.
fields.thumb: The highest-resolution thumbnail URL YouTube returned.
